title: Rana Plaza Collapse
subtitle: The Savar disaster exposed structural failures in Bangladesh's garment supply chain.
summary: On 24 April 2013, Rana Plaza in Savar collapsed, killing over a thousand people and injuring many more. The disaster triggered domestic and international scrutiny of factory safety, labor governance, and global supply-chain accountability.
heroTagline: The Savar disaster exposed structural failures in Bangladesh's garment supply chain.
whyItMatters: Rana Plaza became a structural turning point for labor rights policy, building compliance regimes, and international buyer responsibility in Bangladesh.
